summary: Rockbot, founded in 2009 and led by co-founder/CEO Garrett Dodge, provides a combined music, TV, digital-signage, and advertising media platform used by nearly 50,000 businesses across North America, including restaurant brands such as Subway, Pepper Lunch, and Hot Head Burritos.

Rockbot customer case studies report Hot Head Burritos using the platform across 70+ locations to eliminate franchisee music-licensing burden, and Snooze centralizing music across 70+ locations with a nationwide brand refresh launched in three months. (Scope note: Figures are vendor-published case studies; independent verification of the specific ROI/timeline claims was not available in this pass.)
